user_choice: Run exploratory adaptation; keep the initial model as default and disclose the evaluation limitation
subsequent_user_direction: The goal is to see if we can just train the model to be better at transcription. You can use any combination of datasets
scope: One new warm-start trajectory from the preserved initial final adapter. This amendment supersedes AMI-only membership and the launch-time independent-confirmation gate. Automatic promotion remains prohibited.

training.sampler: A frozen 100,000-visit schedule. Cycle randomized distinct source utterances within each dataset; choose one aligned microphone view proportional to published view_confidence. Unit loss weight after sampling. Keeps expected equal source weight without weighting correlated microphone views as independent utterances.
training.clean_replay: 8,000 deterministic source utterances from LibriSpeech train-clean-100; exclude all their speakers from all evaluation cohorts, including VOiCES and HiFiTTS shared reader identities.
training.rationale: Keep the prior four-domain proportions at approximately 80% of visits and add 20% clean replay to test broad retention. Conservative settings, not claimed optimal.

limitations: The session/speaker populations influenced earlier evaluation and design. Results are exploratory even on newly selected utterances.
The parent pretrained-base training corpus is not independently audited.
VOiCES may have fewer than 128 unused speaker-eligible source utterances per panel; record actual counts.
No product-microphone or independent final age validation.
evaluation.selection: Keep the original primary AMI/CHiME mean WER, all per-domain clean/noisy/age/quiet/noise guards, >=4000 updates and >=1000 distinct AMI sources, fixed validation slots, early stopping and one selected checkpoint. Report nine-cohort macro WER as an additional broad transcription summary.
evaluation.confirmation: One preselected development candidate is compared once with the initial model on the separate exploratory confirmation panel. No runner-up selection from confirmation.
evaluation.publication: Preserve an experimental candidate only. adapter.selected/whistle.selected always identify the unchanged initial default; no automatic deployment or refit.
